title: prefill/decode: chunked speculative prefill + stage-overlap + kernel scheduler + KV cache improvements
author: Priya Ramaswamy
description: Motivation: Reduce tail latency and improve throughput for mixed prefill + decode workloads by overlapping prefill and decode stages, enabling chunked speculative prefill, and making kernel scheduling and KV-cache use more workload-aware. This PR implements a combined set of runtime optimizations (chunked prefill, speculative prefill heuristics, stage overlap windows, adaptive kernel scheduler hooks, and KV cache reservation improvements) plus tests and perf harness changes. Key outcomes: 8-20% end-to-end latency reduction on long-context chat workloads, up to 30% throughput improvement in high-concurrency prefill-heavy workloads, and reduced memory pressure from more efficient KV cache allocation. Changes are gated behind runtime flags and conservative defaults to allow staged rollout.
commits: feat(prefill): implement chunked prefill buffer + chunking API
perf(speculative): add speculative prefill heuristics with time-budget check
perf(scheduler): introduce adaptive kernel scheduler hooks and priority hints
fix(kv-cache): reserve per-request KV window and avoid premature eviction
test: add end-to-end perf tests and microbench harness against perf-lab
docs: runtime flags and rollout notes for chunked/speculative prefill
changed_files: serving/runtime/prefill/chunker.py - chunking orchestration and backpressure control

perf_summary: Long-context chat (8k tokens): median latency -12%, P90 -15%, P99 -8%
High-concurrency prefill-heavy: throughput +25-30% depending on model size
Short prompt (<=64 tokens): negligible regressed latency after conservative gating
KV cache memory usage: -18% on average due to reservation and better eviction timing
rollback_strategy: Runtime flag flags.prefill.stage_overlap=false to disable stage overlap
flags.scheduler.adaptive_enabled=false to revert to previous kernel scheduling
Hotfix: revert the squash commit if unexpected regressions observed
release_notes: Prefill+Decode pipeline improvements: chunked prefill, speculative prefill heuristics, stage overlap windows, adaptive kernel scheduler hooks, and KV cache reservation. Improvements reduce latency and increase throughput for long-context and prefill-heavy workloads. Features are disabled behind conservative flags by default.
testing_notes: Added microbench for short and long context, unit tests for scheduler fallback and KV reservation accounting, and a perf harness job in perf-lab. CI perf job validated improvements; recommend canary rollout on Dedicated clusters before global rollout.
notes_for_ops: Ops: watch new metrics prefilling_stage_overlap_active, speculative_prefill_attempts, kernel_scheduler_hint_rate, kv_reservation_failures. Default flags are conservative; enable flags.prefill.stage_overlap and flags.scheduler.adaptive_enabled in small increments. Increase KV cache headroom on Dedicated nodes if you observe reservation throttling.
